card.title: Hand Over the Proof
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hand me the drawer key before I sign the club accounts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My signature covers the receipts too. Let me check how it adds up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you find a mistake, my name goes on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put mine beside yours. Give me the key and we'll correct it together before either name goes outside this room.

mechanism: A obtains evidence access by addressing the holder's fear of blame and offering shared accountability.
confusable: Unlike an ordinary favor for a key, A must need access to proceed with a concrete responsibility.
comparison: Shared correction of club accounts contrasts with the other alternative's narrowing a private note to one line.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
